ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I
   B. goodbye
   C. I am well
   D. good evening

2. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am well, thanks be to God.
   B. My name is Ahmad.
   C. I am a pupil (boy).
   D. I am a pupil (girl).

3. What is meant by listening for the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Listening for the main idea
   B. Repeating everything loudly
   C. Writing every word you hear
   D. Listening only for names

4. Which Arabic sentence means "The pen is in the bag." (1 mark)
   A. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ
   B. الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   C. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   D. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ

5. What does the Arabic word فَوْقَ (fawqa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. beside
   C. above
   D. at (near, by)

6. What does the Arabic sentence الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I go to school on Monday.
   B. Today is Thursday.
   C. I play on Saturday.
   D. There are seven days in a week.

7. What does the Arabic word السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. yesterday
   C. Friday
   D. week

8. Which Arabic sentence means "Today is Thursday." (1 mark)
   A. أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   B. الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   C. فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ
   D. أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ

9. Which is a rule of good turn taking? (1 mark)
   A. Shout to be heard
   B. Interrupt without saying anything
   C. Wait until the speaker has finished
   D. Speak at the same time as others

10. In the sentence fii s-sabaah aakulu khubzan wa bayDan, which words show that the meal is in the morning? (1 mark)
   A. fii s-sabaah
   B. aakulu
   C. khubzan
   D. wa bayDan

11. What is the sound dh in udhun like in English? (1 mark)
   A. d in 'dog'
   B. th in 'think'
   C. th in 'this'
   D. z in 'zebra'

12. Which body part is used for the action 'aktubu' (I write)? (1 mark)
   A. fam, the mouth
   B. udhun, the ear
   C. anf, the nose
   D. yad, the hand

13. How is the Arabic word رِجْلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dhahr
   B. raqaba
   C. rijl
   D. sinn

14. How do you read the syllable دَ? (1 mark)
   A. da
   B. tu
   C. lu
   D. bi

15. What is the name of the Arabic letter ق? (1 mark)
   A. qaaf
   B. DHaa
   C. Daad
   D. Haa

16. Which sound is made at the back of the throat like the ch in the Scottish word 'loch'? (1 mark)
   A. s (س)
   B. m (م)
   C. b (ب)
   D. kh (خ)

17. Which Arabic sentence means "This is a party." (1 mark)
   A. الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ
   B. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   C. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   D. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ

18. How is the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. lahm
   B. sukkar
   C. jazar
   D. burtuqaal

19. What does the Arabic word قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) mean? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. strong
   C. friend
   D. oranges

20. How is the Arabic word شَعْرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿayn
   B. udhun
   C. wajh
   D. shaʿr

21. Which Arabic word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. شَمْسٌ
   B. غَائِمٌ
   C. مُمْطِرٌ
   D. مُشْمِسٌ

22. Which letter completes the word _ُور to make nuur (light)? (1 mark)
   A. ي (yaa)
   B. ن (nuun)
   C. ت (taa)
   D. ب (baa)

23. How many forms can an Arabic letter have at most? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. One
   C. Two
   D. Four: alone, start, middle and end

24. What does the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. shoulder
   B. new
   C. hand
   D. close the door

25. What does the Arabic word كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. big
   B. maize
   C. Wednesday
   D. cup

26. Which sentence means 'The window is clean'? (1 mark)
   A. at-taawilatu Sagiira
   B. al-baabu kabiir
   C. an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
   D. al-kursiyyu jadiid

27. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat rice.
   B. The banana is delicious.
   C. I drink tea.
   D. The water is clean.

28. Which Arabic word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. شَعْرٌ
   B. أُذُنٌ
   C. جِسْمٌ
   D. رَقَبَةٌ

29. Which of these is unique about Arabic writing? (1 mark)
   A. It is written from right to left
   B. It has 26 letters
   C. It has no dots
   D. It has capital letters

30. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا مَطَرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is the sun.
   B. The sun is hot.
   C. The wind is strong.
   D. This is rain.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

32. Translate into English: hal ʿindaka hafla? (2 marks)

33. Write three Arabic questions about a picture of a party and give their meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Write five foods or drinks in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

35. Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i (2 marks)

36. Translate into English: ukhtii jamiila (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: anaa uhibbu l-hafla (2 marks)

38. Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii (2 marks)

41. Explain why writing the dots correctly is important. Give one example of two letters that differ only by dots. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

43. Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid (2 marks)

44. Describe how you can make flashcards for the days of the week. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: uhibbu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

47. Describe the steps of making a class picture book on family celebrations. (4 marks) (4 marks)

48. Explain why correct spelling is important in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — I am well
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

2. A — I am well, thanks be to God.
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah) means: I am well, thanks be to God.

3. A — Listening for the main idea
   The gist is the main idea. You do not need to understand every word.

4. B — الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

5. C — above
   فَوْقَ (fawqa) means above.

6. B — Today is Thursday.
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

7. A — Saturday
   السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

8. B — الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

9. C — Wait until the speaker has finished
   Good speakers wait for their turn and use polite words if they must interrupt.

10. A — fii s-sabaah
   sabaah means morning, so fii s-sabaah is 'in the morning'.

11. C — th in 'this'
   The letter dh is like the th in 'this'.

12. D — yad, the hand
   We write with the hand (yad).

13. C — rijl
   رِجْلٌ is read rijl and means leg.

14. A — da
   دَ is read da.

15. A — qaaf
   The letter ق is called qaaf.

16. D — kh (خ)
   The letter khaa makes the throat sound kh.

17. C — هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

18. B — sukkar
   سُكَّرٌ is read sukkar and means sugar.

19. B — strong
   قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) means strong.

20. D — shaʿr
   شَعْرٌ is read shaʿr and means hair.

21. A — شَمْسٌ
   شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

22. B — ن (nuun)
   The word nuur (نُور) starts with nuun.

23. D — Four: alone, start, middle and end
   A joining letter can look different alone, at the start, in the middle and at the end of a word.

24. B — new
   جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) means new.

25. A — big
   كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

26. C — an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
   naafidha is window and nadhiifa is the feminine form of clean.

27. C — I drink tea.
   أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ (ashrabu sh-shaaya) means: I drink tea.

28. B — أُذُنٌ
   أُذُنٌ (udhun) means ear.

29. A — It is written from right to left
   Arabic runs from right to left and has 28 letters and no capitals.

30. D — This is rain.
   هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example ayna l-kaʿka? (Where is the cake?) man haadhaa? (Who is this?) maadhaa fawqa t-taawila? (What is above the table?)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct question with meaning.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), dhura (maize), lahm (meat), samak (fish).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: And the rain is from the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister is beautiful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: How beautiful the environment is!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: I write with my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: A wrong dot changes the letter and the word. For example ف has one dot above and ق has two dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for changes the letter, 1 mark for changes the word, 1 mark for a correct example.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Happy birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cut cards; write the Arabic day on the front; write the English name and sound on the back; decorate and display in order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: I go to school on Monday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Collect or draw pictures of celebration things; put one on each page; write an Arabic word or sentence with the meaning; make a cover with a title.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: A missing letter or a wrong dot can change the word, so the reader may not understand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a change in the word and 1 mark for understanding.
